newsitem.title: USA: DuPont shrs off on Conoco rumors.
newsitem.headline: DuPont shrs off on Conoco rumors.

text.p: Shares of DuPont Co fell 2-3/8 to 93-1/8 on market talk that the company would not spin off its Conoco energy unit, traders reported.
The company was to be planning a conference call at 1200 EDT/1700 GMT, according to one trader.
Officials at DuPont and Conoco were not immediately available.

Traders have speculated on a spinoff after Conoco said in June it was restructuring the business and had been in talks with Phillips Petroleum Co on combining refining, marketing and transportation operations.
The restructuring included a reduction in headquarters staff and shuffling other home office workers into business units.
A spokeswoman for DuPont later declined to comment on the company's stock activity or the market speculation, citing corporate policy. She said there was no scheduled meeting with analysts today.
